name: figure-agent-py
description: Python-first semantic SVG renderer and verifier for the Fig1 scientific schematic.

interface.shortDescription: Python semantic SVG Fig1 renderer and verifier.
interface.longDescription: Wraps the experiments/python_svg_semantic_fig1 renderer, gates, and visual judgment report. It renders SVG/PNG from Python scene payloads and scaffold contracts, not TikZ .tex sources.
defaultPrompt: Run the Fig1 semantic SVG gates.
Check the Fig1 visual judgment report.
